newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER SHOWCASE-NO-NONSENSE REFEREE TAKES CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-NO-NONSENSE REFEREE TAKES CHARGE.

text.p: The referee for Sunday's highly-charged Dutch first division clash between Feyenoord and Ajax Amsterdam is Enschede-born Jaap Uilenberg.
The 46-year-old part-time bank worker, with a reputation as a no-nonsense "man in the middle", began refereeing 20 years ago and has been on FIFA's international books since 1989.
His assistants will be Hans Vuurman (39), a geography and history teacher, from Arnhem and Henk Roelofsen (48), a local planning chief from Weert in the southern Netherlands.
